DEGENERACY._claim: g_str's lateral bearing component never points LEFT
DEGENERACY.statistic: gstr_nav_true[:,1] (the sin/lateral component of the unit bearing); +y is LEFT (orientation control in CONTINGENCY.json PASSES)
DEGENERACY._reads: the head VARIES but its SIGN never does: a direction class constant at RIGHT. A structural zero, not an estimate -- the same family as H-ECHO-4.

GROUND_TRUTH_FOR_CONTRAST.rule: GT terminal lateral y, deadband tau_y = 1.0 m
GROUND_TRUTH_FOR_CONTRAST._reads: ground truth turns LEFT on these windows while g_str never once points that way

PRESENCE_VS_CONTENT_gstr._statistic: MEAN over windows of relative L2 displacement of the g_str 3-vector vs nav_true
PRESENCE_VS_CONTENT_gstr._warning: normalisation-dependent: quote WITH this definition or not at all
PRESENCE_VS_CONTENT_gstr._reads: the strategic head responds to nav's PRESENCE, not its CONTENT -- the presence-gating already measured at the planner, reproduced one level up

PLAN_DISPLACEMENT_full_bank._statistic: plan TERMINAL displacement (m) vs nav_true, over the FULL banked dump (not the 29-episode panel subset)
PLAN_DISPLACEMENT_full_bank._reads: inverting the commanded route changes the emitted plan by EXACTLY ZERO on most windows
